title: Real-child probe diagnostic tests still run under the production 2 s bound and can time out under parallel test load
outcome: The real-child tests in src/tests/federation_probe_diagnostics.rs (success_keeps_fixed_marker_contract, nonzero_exit_is_not_a_spawn_failure, spawn_failure_uses_native_launch_boundary) cannot fail from start-up load: either they run under a test guard bound, with production-bound expiry covered only by the deterministic held-child tests, or the coordinator records why one real child must stay on the production bound and how that exposure is made deterministic.
acceptance: A coordinator ruling on whether a real child must exercise the production bound to completion (a condition Fable2 set on w-31fee749ec69, #3146 iii) is recorded here, and the tests follow it.

The affected tests are deterministic under gate load (no fixed 2 s exposure without a recorded reason), the full gate is green, and an independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding.
